snippet.title: No Sun To Worship Available On Consoles Now! – Watch The Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The acclaimed indie stealth-action title is finally available on PS5, XBOX X|S, and Nintendo Switch!

No Sun To Worship nails the core experience of classic stealth, drawing inspiration from legends like Metal Gear Solid and Splinter Cell.

Set against the eerie backdrop of a post-nuclear world, it puts you in the boots of a lone operative tasked with slipping past defenses, taking out key targets, and disappearing without a trace.

Featuring lo-fi PS1-inspired visuals, six carefully crafted missions, and a variety of ways to approach each objective, it’s a love letter to old-school stealth - tense, tactical, and brutally unforgiving.

Every bullet counts. Every shadow matters. Your silence is your strongest weapon.

Originally a hidden gem on PC, it’s now gearing up for its console debut. Created by Merlino Games and proudly brought to PS5, XBOX X|S, and Nintendo Switch! by Hyperstrange.

Get No Sun To Worship today!

https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/no-sun-to-worship/9N4RMZH9T4B0/0010

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013107

https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/no-sun-to-worship-switch/
